g.text: CSA exceeds PCA30 in the gray Euclidean comparison and PCA24 in the Gabor equal-budget Euclidean comparison, but remains below Gabor PCA33.
Cosine favors PCA more strongly. These metric controls share current inputs; they differ from earlier mixed-input published headline tables.
Previously observed probes; no general superiority claim.
